modulesSection.description: Everything you need to run real client books on GIDDH — structured into three focused modules with practical walkthroughs and an online certification exam.

faqs.question: Is the certification really free?
faqs.answer: Yes. All three modules, learning materials, the certification exam, and your verified digital badge are completely free with no hidden fees.

faqs.question: Do I need to be a partner to take the course?
faqs.answer: No. Anyone — accountants, bookkeepers, resellers, consultants, or business owners — can enroll and complete the certification before joining the GIDDH Partnership Program.

faqs.question: What happens if I fail the exam?
faqs.answer: You need an overall score of at least 70% across all three modules to pass. Two attempts will be provided, followed by a one-month retake period.

faqs.question: How does the partner revenue share actually work?
faqs.answer: Once enrolled in the GIDDH Partnership Program, you earn 50% on a referred client's first-year subscription, 30% on the second-year renewal, and 20% on the third consecutive year renewal, settled quarterly.

faqs.question: How is the certificate generated?
faqs.answer: After you pass, your certificate is issued by Walkover Technologies Pvt Ltd with your score, issue date and 6-month validity. You can view it online and download it as a PDF.

faqs.question: What makes certification helpful for my first client setup?
faqs.answer: The modules walk you through real GIDDH ledger setup, data migration, tax configuration, and multi-user access so your first client onboarding goes smoothly from day one.
